tasks.title: Write lockout + degraded window + guard fix + docs + tests
tasks.objective: The orchestrating session physically cannot write product or canon: the hook denies always (even under an approved plan), forge delegate is the sole write path, a ledgered degraded window is the single exception, and read-only Codex rescue works again so discovery routes where the contract says.
acceptance_criteria: repo_kind.py gains the shared locked-path classifier (repo-kind-aware); pre_tool_use denies session Edit/Write/Notebook and Bash write-shapes on locked paths ALWAYS unless an open degraded window, with the deny naming forge delegate and forge mode degraded start; exempt surfaces (docs/, plans/, .factory/ recorders, prototype/, .gstack/, git ops incl. the commit belt ordering) behave exactly as today. FIRST re-verify that companion worker writes bypass Claude hooks; raise a signal if not.

forge mode degraded start --reason opens a ledgered window on the quickfix ledger (kind degraded, required reason, 5-file claim budget); mode done closes it; the done record satisfies Gate A declare-all unchanged; pre_tool_use honors the window via the existing claim path.

The companion guard admits read-only invocations by argument content (status, task-resume-candidate, task without --write; quoting alone never denies) ANYTIME - stage- and phase-independent: a read-only invocation succeeds with no active task, no approved plan, in any phase, in harness and client repos alike (operator contract 2026-08-11: 'read only can happen anytime') - and still refuses write-shaped or executor-wrapped calls; all three directions tested including the no-active-stage case.

AGENTS.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md state the routing within their caps (110 and 40 lines) via in-place reclaims; docs/degraded-mode.md is rewritten around the window as the single exception; D-0007 gets the fifth-site progress note appended to its deferral row.

Tests: deny-under-approved-plan incl. AGENTS.md and .github/; allow-inside-degraded-window with claims and budget; exemptions writable; window ledger record; guard admission both ways; test_harness_repo_keeps_docs_and_planning_surfaces_writable updated for AGENTS.md moving sides. Full suite green.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "lockout or degraded or companion or planning_lock or harness_repo"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The exempt set must keep every recorder and git path alive (the orchestrator finishes THIS story under the lockout - if it bricks the loop, the story cannot ship); worker-write bypass verified not assumed; guard admission must not accept executor wrapping; deny messages name both remedies; caps hold.
